titles.title: HalfLife1
titles.engine_and_build: WON GoldSrc, Half-Life 1.1.0.8. version.txt reads '1.1.0.8 9/24/2001', network protocol 45. hl.exe (942,080 B, md5 77cce9925d2a039ae38b679b1225e944, PE link 2001-09-11) is the WON launcher. It sets the fullscreen mode itself; the engine does not. It imports USER32!ChangeDisplaySettingsA (IAT 0x4ac42c) and DDRAW!DirectDrawCreate. hw.dll (1,175,552 B, md5 374a87fd6175a6a9541656bc959bc822, 2001-09-21) imports no ChangeDisplaySettings* at all. sw.dll: 1,056,768 B, md5 8dca902ec1e31441adf5fde45c90b378. Mods: valve, gearbox, bshift, tfc, dmc. Opposing Force and Blue Shift never start a map on any box (KNOWN-BROKEN-bshift-and-gearbox.txt; the compat matrix shows X).
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed in C:\Games\HalfLife1 on .123, .124, .145, .195 and .240 (DIRLIST at 03:55 EDT). On all five boxes every key file has the library's byte size: hl.exe, hw.dll, sw.dll, the 5 .bat launchers, FLEETRES.BAT/.EXE, install.reg and launch.txt. Half-Life.bat on .123 and .124 has md5 831154da..., identical to the library copy.

Not on .243: its C:\Games has 12 dirs and a case-insensitive search for half/counter/cstrike finds nothing; the compat matrix marks it 'G.' (gated). .124's D:\Games is empty.

Launchers (launch.txt): Half-Life.bat, Opposing Force.bat, Blue Shift.bat, Team Fortress Classic.bat and Deathmatch Classic.bat. Each does `call FLEETRES.BAT`, then `start "" hl.exe -nosierra -full -gl -w %FR_W43% -h %FR_H43% -toconsole [-game gearbox|bshift|tfc|dmc]`.

Renderer: -gl means OpenGL everywhere. At 0x423c84, -gl/-opengl sets EngineType=2; at 0x40e83c type 2 releases the DirectDraw object, so the mode goes through ChangeDisplaySettingsA.

OpenGL ICD per box:
- .123: ATI Radeon HD 3850, driver 8.970.
- .240: HWPROFILE now reports Radeon X1600 Series (driver 8.593), not the X800 in the shared context.
- .145: GeForce 8400GS, driver 6.14.13.4052 (ForceWare 340.52).
- .195: AMD HD 5450 on Windows 7.
- .124: our MesaFX retroicd.dll (the system ICD) over our h5 system32\glide3x.dll (md5 38a891e81ea58379a0c22be6d7c0d6fb, RETRO3DFX_SLIAA_GUARD build) on vcr-kmd. On this box Glide controls the scan-out.
titles.resolution_per_box:
All five boxes run it at FR_W43 x FR_H43 = 1280x960.
- .123/.145/.195/.240: 1280x960 on 1920x1080 LCDs (GAMERES four_three).
- .124: 1280x960 on the 4:3 CRT.

WON is 4:3-only. Its -w/-h beats the shared HKCU ScreenWidth/Height, which is 1920x1080 on the LCD boxes (GAMERES writes that value for Counter-Strike).

.124 is measured. The sibling capture evidence-refresh/124-window/run2.txt (03:59:05) ran HalfLife1\hl.exe as pid 1716, the same pid that loads at C:\retrogl.log line 4684. The vcr-kmd ring shows 'mode 89: 1280x960x16@60' (the engine's own set), then 'mode 199: 1280x960x32@75' (Glide). DISPLAYCFG during the run read {1280x960, 32 bpp, refresh 75}.

The LCD boxes were not measured in this phase.
titles.refresh_control:
None in the title.

Evidence (hl1-cs16/static/verify_static.txt and disasm_excerpts.txt):
- hl.exe has exactly one DEVMODE-building call, sub_464070. It sets dmFields=0x1C0000 (BITSPERPEL|PELSWIDTH|PELSHEIGHT; `mov dword ptr [esp+0x34],0x1c0000` at 0x4640af). dmDisplayFrequency stays 0. It then calls ChangeDisplaySettingsA(&dm, 4=CDS_FULLSCREEN) at 0x4640bb.
- The other 3 calls through IAT 0x4ac42c (0x4240cd, 0x464155, 0x46cf5b) are CDS(NULL,0) desktop restores.
- No instruction anywhere in hl.exe moves or ORs DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY (0x400000).
- The software and D3D paths use IDirectDraw v1 SetDisplayMode(w,h,bpp) (vtable +0x54, at 0x408666), which has no refresh argument.
- The mode table does carry a refresh at +0x24; the video dialog prints it as '%d x %d %d hz' (string at 0x4d2874, used at 0x46d083). But sub_4640d0 passes only w/h/bpp on to the mode set.
- An exact NUL-delimited search finds no '-freq' or '-refresh' string in hl.exe or hw.dll. strings -a (case-insensitive) finds only r_norefresh, timerefresh and r_glowshellfreq, none of which is a refresh rate.
- HKCU\Software\Valve\Half-Life\Settings holds no refresh value.

.124 only: Glide's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH decides the scan-out. Glide reads it from the process environment, then HKCU, then HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide (minihwc.c getRegPath 1404-1406, hwcGetenv 9553-9590). hwcInitVideo applies it at 4675-4676, after the ICD's own request.
titles.set_today:
Nothing refresh-related is set today.
- Launchers: the 5 launchers pass no rate. FLEETRES.BAT publishes FR_HZ but no launcher uses it. The deployed copies are md5-identical to the library.
- GAMERES rules: there is no HalfLife1 rule. The rows in gameres.h keyed 'CounterStrike16' write the shared Valve key (ScreenWidth/Height, EngineMode*, EngineType=1, EngineGLDriver=Default). That key has no rate value to write.
- Desktop raise: gameres_raise_refresh raised nothing, because the persisted desktops are already at their best (LCD boxes 1920x1080@60, .124 1280x1024@85; hz_launcher/FRHZ is 60 and 85). A desktop rate cannot reach this engine anyway: its fullscreen CDS drops it (see expected).
- .124 Glide key: a vendor-panel leftover sets FX_GLIDE_REFRESH='75' (REG_SZ) in HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide (read 03:55 EDT). There is no HKCU mirror and it is not in the system or user environment, so this value forces 75 Hz on every Glide open. Our ICD asks for 85: all 15 HalfLife1\hl.exe sessions in C:\retrogl.log log 'fxBestRefresh: 1280x960 max 85 Hz (EnumDisplaySettings) -> GR_REFRESH enum 7' and a successful open.
titles.best_per_box:
At 1280x960:
- .123: 75 Hz (GAMERES '1280x960@75'; DELL P2312H, EDID vmax 76)
- .145: 75 (DELL E2414H, vmax 76)
- .240: 75 (DELL E2313H digital, vmax 76; its EDID reads again as of 03:55)
- .195: 60 (HP 2511; every mode is @60)
- .124: 85 (HP P1120 CRT, vmax 160). The vcr-kmd ring shows 1280x960x32 at 60/75/85 (modes 159/199/160), so 85 is the maximum.
- .243: not applicable (not deployed; the box has no EDID, so its best is unknown).
titles.expected_today_per_box:
.124: 75 Hz, measured. In 124-window/run2.txt (03:59:05), while HalfLife1 hl.exe pid 1716 ran, DISPLAYCFG read {1280x960x32, refresh 75}. After HWCSETEXCLUSIVE the vcr-kmd ring shows 'mode 199: 1280x960x32@75, pll 129884->129886 kHz, refresh 75014 mHz'. Before that, the engine's own rate-less CDS had landed at 60 ('mode 89: 1280x960x16@60') even though the desktop was persisted at 85. Glide then re-set the mode to 75 from FX_GLIDE_REFRESH.

.123, .145 and .240: 60 Hz, unmeasured. This is inferred, because WON's CDS names no rate. On XP a fullscreen CDS with no rate gets the adapter default of 60, not the desktop rate and not the best rate. That is measured three times:
- .124 on ForceWare 71.89 (2026-08-25), even at the same resolution as a 100 Hz desktop (retro-3dfx/FINDINGS.md; agent/tools/refreshlogic.h).
- .143 on ForceWare 71.89 (docs/benchmarks/143-geforce6800-2026-09-27.md).
- vcr-kmd on .124 today.

On the ATI boxes, a 'keep the previous rate' policy would still give 60, because the desktop it would carry over is 1920x1080@60. The .123 miniport ati2mtag.sys contains the string DALRULE_APPLYPREVIOUSREFRESHRATE; whether that rule is enabled is unknown.

.195: 60, the only rate listed at 1280x960 (unmeasured).
titles.gap:
- .123: -15 Hz (60 vs 75)
- .145: -15 Hz
- .240: -15 Hz
(For all three, 60 is the unmeasured expectation and 75 is the listed best.)
- .195: 0
- .124: -10 Hz (75 measured vs 85 listed). The stale FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 causes this, not the engine.
- .243: not applicable
titles.fix:
WON 1.1.0.8 has no per-title cvar, switch, ini or registry value for refresh, so this needs generic mechanisms.

(1) Non-Glide boxes (.123, .145, .240; .195 would be a no-op): re-apply the mode from outside the game.
- agent/tools/refreshkeep.exe already does this. It re-applies the current mode with DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY using flags 0 (never CDS_UPDATEREGISTRY), refuses any rate the driver does not list at that WxHxBPP, and exits when the watched process does. It held UT/Q2 OpenGL at 100 Hz on .143.
- FLEETRES.EXE must publish FR_HZ43 = gr_best_hz(FR_W43, FR_H43) with the EDID cap, and 0 when there is no EDID. gameres.h already computes this as t->hz43 ('hz_four_three'). Mirror it in fleetres.c, add the fallback `if not defined FR_HZ43 set FR_HZ43=0` in stage-fleetres.py, and pin it in test_gameres_mirror.py and test_fleetres_staging.py.
- Stage the keeper in the tree, or fold it into FLEETRES.EXE as a -keep mode. It must not show a console: build it -mwindows or start it hidden.
- stage-fleetres.py then emits this into all 5 HalfLife1 launchers, before `start "" hl.exe`:
  `if "%FR_GLIDE%"=="0" if not "%FR_HZ43%"=="0" start "" /min "%~dp0REFRESHKEEP.EXE" %FR_HZ43% hl.exe 7200`
- Never use refreshkeep's `max` mode (it has no EDID cap), and never use FR_HZ (the desktop's rate at a different resolution: 60 on the LCD boxes).
- Result: .123/.145/.240 run 1280x960 at 75.

(2) .124 (FR_GLIDE=1): Glide controls the scan-out, so the keeper must not run there.
- Preferred: remove the stale FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 from HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide (3dfxctl 'Fullscreen refresh rate' set to Auto). Our ICD's fxBestRefresh request (85 at 1280x960) then reaches Glide, which fixes every Glide title on the box at once. This needs explicit OK from the operator or the V5 6000 session, because docs/v56k-benchmark-plan.md records 'FX_GLIDE_REFRESH 75' as box state.
- Launcher-only alternative: `if "%FR_GLIDE%"=="1" if not "%FR_HZ43%"=="0" set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZ43%`. hwcGetenv reads the process environment before the registry, and nothing but a 3dfx Glide reads this variable.
titles.fix_risk:
Keeper:
- It makes a second mode switch about 1 s after the engine's own, so an LCD blanks while it resyncs. It also switches once during WON's 640x480x16 launcher mode.
- OpenGL context survival across a refresh-only CDS is measured only on NVIDIA 71.89 (UT and Q2 on .143). It is unmeasured on Catalyst (.123/.240), on ForceWare 340.52 (.145), and with GoldSrc on any driver.
- After an alt-tab the game's restore drops back to 60 until the next 1 s poll.
- On a Glide box the keeper would call ChangeDisplaySettings while Glide holds exclusive mode on the V5 6000. That is untested, and that box wedges hard. The FR_GLIDE gate prevents it, but FR_GLIDE is a PCI-enum VEN_121A test (0 on .123/.145/.195/.240 today, 1 on .124), so a ghost 3dfx key would make it misfire.
- 75 Hz is inside the EDID range (vmax 76), but a 60 Hz-native LCD scaler may frame-convert it. Check the monitor OSD.

.124:
- Changing a Glide setting changes the benchmark box's recorded state.
- The 1280x960@85 mode itself is proven on this tube: Q3's own CDS programs it routinely (ring 'mode 160: 1280x960x32@85'). Pace the mode switches.
titles.verify_on_hw:
Test fullscreen through the staged shortcut only.

LCD boxes (.123/.145/.240/.195):
1. Launch Half-Life.bat (also TFC and DMC) and wait about 25 s past the WON console.
2. Run `DISPLAYCFG get`. Today expect {1280x960, refresh 60}; after the fix, 75.
3. `WINLIST` should show 'Half-Life' at 0,0-1280,960. Also read the monitor OSD.
4. After the fix, the keeper's log should show 't=Ns 1280x960xB 60Hz -> 75Hz: rc=0'.
5. After exit, DISPLAYCFG should be back at 1920x1080@60.

.124 (only with the V5 session's agreement, and paced):
- Run DISPLAYCFG get while the game runs.
- Run `C:\vcr\vcrctl.exe log` and read events 300/301 after HWCSETEXCLUSIVE: 'mode N: 1280x960x32@Hz' and 'pll ... refresh NNNNN mHz'.
- Check the fxBestRefresh line in C:\retrogl.log.
titles.verifier_notes:
(a) The premise in several places is false for GoldSrc: gameres.h's NOTE ON REFRESH, the gr_raise_desktop_refresh comment in gameres.c, and CLAUDE.md say these engines take whatever the desktop is on, and that raising the desktop reaches every title. In fact both GoldSrc builds issue a fullscreen CDS, and without a rate it lands at 60 regardless of the desktop. That is measured on .124 today and on 2026-08-25.

(b) gameres.h says 'EngineType 1 = hardware/OpenGL'. That is wrong for WON hl.exe, where 1 = software, 2 = OpenGL and 3 = D3D (0x423c4c-0x423cd8). WON writes the value back, and .124 reads 2. It is harmless because all 5 launchers pass -gl.

(c) stage-fleetres.py's HalfLife1 rule still maps '-w 1024 -h 768' to %FR_W%/%FR_H%, the 16:9 pair that drops WON to 400x300. It is a no-op on the current tree, but it would regress a re-staged original.

(d) Catalyst's 3D_Refresh_Rate_Override_DEF is 0 on .123 and .240 (mechanism/boxes/*Video*0000*). It is a single global rate for every 3D mode, 75 is not listed at 1920x1080, and whether it applies to OpenGL is unverified, so it is not the recommended lever.

(e) Moving Half-Life to the build-4554 engine would give it -freq, but that tree's valve\ has no maps and none of the mods.

Evidence is in /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/evidence-refresh/hl1-cs16/ (live/, static/, tools/) and in the sibling capture .claude/evidence-refresh/124-window/run2.txt.

titles.title: CounterStrike16
titles.engine_and_build:
Steam-era GoldSrc from a no-Steam repack. The launcher comment identifies it as 'No Steam V42, build 4554, protocol 48', with BCShield 2.5 (bcs16.ro).
- hl.exe (86,077 B, md5 2098ccf443433129b556c2849fe99e26, 2008-10-22) is only an engine loader with no display imports. It passes the command line through to hw.dll.
- hw.dll (1,840,440 B, md5 4903e8e80f2a00d3ab2886f0f209a6d6, linked 2009-06-15) owns the mode. It has IVideoMode classes with vtables CVideoMode_OpenGL 0x1e4a5f0, CVideoMode_Direct3DFullScreen 0x1e4a63c and VideoMode_Direct3DWindowed 0x1e4a688, and imports ChangeDisplaySettingsA (IAT 0x1e483c4).
- sw.dll: 1,672,504 B.
- Counter-Strike.exe is a stub that spawns hl.exe without forwarding arguments.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed in C:\Games\CounterStrike16 on .123, .124, .145, .195 and .240; file sizes match the library. Play Counter-Strike.bat on .123 and .124 has md5 6f53e61b..., identical to the library copy.

Not on .243: the compat matrix marks it 'G.' (gated); the title's min_cpu is 233 and the box is a P166.

Launchers:
- 'Play Counter-Strike.bat': `start "" hl.exe -game cstrike -full -gl -w %FR_W% -h %FR_H%`
- 'Play Half-Life Deathmatch.bat': `-game valve -full -gl -w %FR_W% -h %FR_H% +connect 192.168.1.132:27020`
Both set MESA_FORCE_SSE=1.

Renderer: -gl selects CVideoMode_OpenGL. The check order at 0x1dc7aac-0x1dc7acf is -d3d first, then -gl, then the registry's EngineD3D. So -gl overrides the stale EngineD3D=1 that .145 and .240 carry.

.124: OpenGL goes through our MesaFX ICD over our h5 Glide, so Glide controls the scan-out. That box also has box-only V56KBENCH.BAT and LANCHECK.BAT from the benchmark session.
titles.resolution_per_box:
FR_W x FR_H:
- .123, .145, .195, .240: 1920x1080, the LCD native mode. HKCU ScreenWidth/Height (written by GAMERES) also reads 1920x1080.
- .124: 1280x960, the 4:3 CRT target. The registry reads 1280x960, and all 9 CounterStrike16\hl.exe sessions in C:\retrogl.log opened 1280x960.
titles.refresh_control:
A `-freq <hz>` command-line switch, matched exactly and case-sensitively by COM_CheckParm. There is no cvar and no ini or registry value.

The switch works in CVideoMode_OpenGL slot 17 at 0x1dc75f0, the ChangeDisplaySettings-to-fullscreen routine:
- The DEVMODE starts with dmFields=0x1C0000 (0x1dc7635).
- It pushes 0x1e8cb0c ('-freq') and calls COM_CheckParm at 0x1d383e0 (0x1dc7640).
- If found, it sets dmDisplayFrequency = atoi(argv[i+1]) at 0x1dc7661-0x1dc7666 (DEVMODE+0x78) and ORs 0x400000 into dmFields at 0x1dc7674.
- It then calls ChangeDisplaySettingsA(&dm, CDS_FULLSCREEN) at 0x1dc7684 and never checks the return value.

Slot 16 (0x1dc75c0) is the CDS(NULL,0) restore.

The OpenGL-to-D3D wrapper also reads -freq (push 0x1e7e434 at 0x1d7bb90). That is measured on .124 on 2026-08-03: retro-3dfx/FINDINGS.md records 'D3D mode DOES honor GoldSrc -freq 100 ... without it D3D runs 60Hz'.

There is no '-refresh' string; the only related cvars are r_norefresh and timerefresh. On .124, Glide's FX_GLIDE_REFRESH overrides whatever the engine set (see HalfLife1).
titles.set_today:
No rate is set today.
- Launchers: neither launcher passes -freq; FR_HZ is unused.
- GAMERES rules (the gameres.h GoldSrc block, GR_OP_REG on HKCU\Software\Valve\Half-Life\Settings) write ScreenWidth/EngineModeW=%W%, ScreenHeight/EngineModeH=%H%, BPP 32, windowed 0, EngineType 1 and EngineGLDriver 'Default'. Read back at 03:55 they are 1920x1080 on the LCD boxes and 1280x960 on .124. None of these is a refresh value.
- Desktop raise: nothing to raise. The LCD desktops' 1920x1080@60 is already the best, and .124's 1280x1024 is at 85.
- .124 Glide key: FX_GLIDE_REFRESH='75'.
titles.best_per_box:
- .123, .145, .195, .240: 60 Hz at 1920x1080 (GAMERES '1920x1080@60'; it is the highest rate the drivers list at native under EDID vmax 76).
- .124: 85 Hz at 1280x960.
- .243: not applicable.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
.123, .145, .240, .195: 60 Hz at 1920x1080. This is unmeasured but bounded. The engine's rate-less CDS gets the driver default, and 60 is the highest rate listed there, so no outcome can be better. A lower default is possible only if a driver lists a lower 1080p rate; GAMERES keeps only the best rate per mode, so it would not show one.

.124: 75 Hz. This is inferred with high confidence but not measured for CS:
- CS takes the same ICD-to-Glide path as HalfLife1.
- The ICD asks for 85 in every CS session (retrogl.log), and FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 replaces it at every open (minihwc.c 4675-4676).
- 75 is measured on the same box today for HalfLife1 and for Q2, Q3 and GLQuake (124-window/run1.txt and run2.txt), even though Q3's own CDS had asked for 85.
titles.gap:
- LCD boxes (.123, .145, .195, .240): 0 (60 is the best at 1920x1080).
- .124: -10 Hz (75 vs 85, inferred).
- .243: not applicable.
titles.fix:
(1) Make it robust per box using the switch the engine already has.
- FLEETRES.EXE publishes FR_HZW = gr_best_hz(FR_W, FR_H) with the EDID cap, and 0 when unknown. gameres.h already computes this as t->hz (GAMERES 'target.hz').
- stage-fleetres.py's CounterStrike16 entry currently lists only Play Counter-Strike.bat; add Play Half-Life Deathmatch.bat. The entry emits `set FR_FREQ=` and `if not "%FR_HZW%"=="0" set FR_FREQ=-freq %FR_HZW%`, and appends %FR_FREQ% to the hl.exe line.
- Today this passes -freq 60 on the LCD boxes, which changes nothing. It gives the best rate on any box whose best at the CS mode is above XP's 60 default, such as a CRT box.
- Never pass FR_HZ, which is the desktop's rate at a different resolution. hw.dll ignores the CDS result, so a rate that is not listed would go unnoticed.

(2) .124: -freq cannot help, because Glide re-sets the mode after the engine does (measured with Q3: its CDS asked for 85 and Glide set 75). Apply the same fix as HalfLife1:
- Preferred: remove FX_GLIDE_REFRESH (set it to Auto), with the V5 session's OK.
- Or add to both launchers: `if "%FR_GLIDE%"=="1" if not "%FR_HZW%"=="0" set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=%FR_HZW%`.
titles.fix_risk:
- LCD boxes: low risk. An explicit 60 is what they already get.
- The -freq value must be listed at that exact WxH, because the engine never checks whether the CDS failed. Use FR_HZW, never FR_HZ or a constant.
- A new FLEETRES variable means regenerating FLEETRES.BAT in every staged title and updating the mirror tests. Verify each file as it is written to the library, because gvfs drops writes.
- .124: same risks as for HalfLife1.
titles.verify_on_hw:
LCD boxes:
1. Launch the 'Counter-Strike 1.6' shortcut fullscreen.
2. At the menu, run `DISPLAYCFG get` and expect {1920x1080, refresh 60}.
3. `WINLIST` should show 'Counter-Strike' at 0,0-1920,1080. Also check the monitor OSD.

After adding -freq, confirm it on a box whose best rate at the CS mode differs from 60: a CRT box (.133, .143 or .171 when powered on) or .124. Read DISPLAYCFG while the game runs.

.124 (with the V5 session's agreement, paced):
- Run DISPLAYCFG get while the game runs.
- Run `C:\vcr\vcrctl.exe log` and read 'mode N: 1280x960x32@Hz' and 'refresh NNNNN mHz' after HWCSETEXCLUSIVE.
- Check C:\retrogl.log.
titles.verifier_notes:
(a) gameres.h and stage-fleetres.py say 'GoldSrc carries no refresh cvar'. That is true for cvars, but build 4554's hw.dll has the -freq switch, so this title does not need the desktop-raise route.

(b) The August scripts/game-refresh/deploy_game_refresh.py passed '-freq {hz} -refresh {hz}' on pre-library install paths. -refresh exists in neither build, and -freq does nothing in WON.

(c) .145 and .240 carry a stale EngineD3D=1. It is harmless with -gl, but Counter-Strike.exe (which forwards no arguments) would start D3D at the D3D default of 60.

(d) The staged tree has no refresh setting in any cfg, bat, reg or ini (case-insensitive search); config.cfg only sets fps_max.

Evidence is in /home/voidsstr/development/retro-agent/.claude/evidence-refresh/hl1-cs16/: static/verify_static.txt, static/disasm_excerpts.txt, live/probe-*.json, live/probe-124-glide.json, live/files/124_retrogl.txt and live/pci-enum.json.
